claim: Distance-aware sample-based uncertainty (SDE, DSDE) discriminates pass@1 failures with AUROC above 0.8 on LiveCodeBench across four closed models.
stance_target: L1: execution-graded code-confidence evaluation is partly occupied for sampled readouts
scope_conditions: LiveCodeBench Python; closed-source API models plus DeepSeek-Coder-V2; Sec 4.2, Table 2
quoted_support: DSDE achieves AUROC above 0.8 in every setting, and both metrics correlate negatively with partial_pass@1

breadth.confidence_families: sample-based behavioural disagreement (SDE, DSDE) vs DiffTrust, HonestCoder, Semantic Entropy baselines (Sec 4.2)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite, Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 (Sec 4.1); sizes undisclosed

claim: The paper's models and pass@1 rates: GPT-3.5-Turbo 30.83%, GPT-4o-mini 49.24%, Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 60.53%, Claude Opus 4.5 82.73%, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 38.14% on LiveCodeBench.
